rules: Work on ONE feature at a time
Read ## Codebase Patterns section FIRST each iteration
Never edit or remove feature definitions
Test end-to-end before marking passes: true
Add reusable patterns to TOP of progress.txt
Append feature log to BOTTOM of progress.txt
Update AGENTS.md if you learn module-specific patterns

features.description: Font sizes reduced to 10 tokens with 16px base
steps: Update tailwind.config.ts fontSize section with new scale
Replace text-2xs with text-xs in all components
Replace text-7xl/8xl/9xl with text-6xl in all components
Run pnpm build to verify no errors
Check Home page renders with correct font sizes
Update tailwind.config.ts boxShadow section with new tokens
Replace shadow-soft-xl/2xl/3xl with shadow-soft-lg
Replace shadow-soft-dark with shadow-dark
Replace shadow-offset-sm/md/lg with shadow-offset
Replace shadow-button with shadow-soft-md
Replace shadow-form with shadow-card
Remove shadow-glow-yellow and shadow-offset-{color} usages
Run pnpm build to verify no errors
Update tailwind.config.ts colors section with nested structure
Replace ocobo-yellowLight with ocobo-yellow-light in all files
Replace ocobo-mintLight with ocobo-mint-light in all files
Replace ocobo-skyLight with ocobo-sky-light in all files
Replace ocobo-coralLight with ocobo-coral-light in all files
Run pnpm build to verify no errors
Verify Badge component renders correctly with all theme colors
Remove rounded-4xl/5xl/6xl/7xl from tailwind.config.ts
Replace rounded-4xl with rounded-3xl in all files
Replace rounded-5xl with rounded-3xl in all files
Replace rounded-6xl with rounded-3xl in all files
Replace rounded-7xl with rounded-3xl in all files
Replace rounded-[2rem], rounded-[2.5rem], rounded-[3rem] with rounded-3xl
Run pnpm build to verify no errors
Run pnpm build
Verify exit code 0
No Tailwind purge warnings for removed tokens
Run pnpm test
Verify all tests pass
No snapshot mismatches
